title: First Come First Served: The Impact of File Position on Code Review
role: prior controlled counterevidence; rejects broad novelty claim and supplies triangulation target
evidence_note: Reports 64% lower odds of detecting one seeded defect type when its file is last rather than first; the second defect type has no position effect. Results establish neither a universal effect nor direct comparability with the 2026 post-review-fix proxy.

title: Securing the AI Supply Chain: What Can We Learn From Developer-Reported Security Issues and Solutions of AI Projects?
role: version-level check of previously sampled v1; verify update status, not independent replication
sections_checked: abstract claims and headline sample/corpus counts
evidence_note: arXiv lists v1 on 2025-12-29 and v2 on 2026-01-09; both abstract records retain 312,868 discussions and the 753-post/32-issue/24-solution headline. The v2 exact PDF used in batch76 adds no change to the previously logged abstract-level claim, but this is the same paper, not independent counterevidence.

title: An Empirical Study of the Evolution of GitHub Actions Workflows
role: prior random-arm study on software-supply-chain controls; outcome-construct counterevidence
evidence_note: Large workflow history corpus reports changes toward more precise permissions/pinning but does not observe attacks prevented; before/after LLM analysis is observational and not conclusive. Previously read in batch30; reconciled only in this batch.
